selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F13 R119 bounded live adoption of the shared disassembly producer map for the 15 already-proven DispTimeAttack2D HUD callsites.
summary: R119 begins live closure of Set04/F13 without broadening HUD heuristics. The existing 15 DispTimeAttack2D callsites preserve their immediate SCREEN_HUD handoff, but each hook now carries its exact caller RVA into a templated callback whose scope is derived through GameSemantic::ClassifyCriticalProducer -> DisasmContract::ClassifyCriticalProducer. A compile-time assertion requires every selected callsite to remain canonical ScreenHud, and the backend disassembly verifier rejects regression to the legacy non-templated hardcoded callback. This is one bounded producer-family adoption only; it does not claim all shared producer ranges are runtime-authoritative.

risk_review.reason: The common UI hook path changes how an already-exact TimeAttack HUD semantic is sourced, so HUD behavior is runtime-visible risk even though the intended scope is unchanged. No Quest3/VDXR test was performed; hosted CI proves build/contract consistency only. vr-d3d9ex-focus itself was not modified.
